visual_action: The video displays a graphic styled like a news alert for a "KEY RACE CALL". The graphic announces that Chris Taylor has won the Wisconsin Supreme Court election, showing a photo of her in judge's robes. Below the photo, text identifies her as the "PROJECTED WINNER". The video then cuts to a second, more casual photo of Chris Taylor smiling outdoors.

cast.name: Chris Taylor
cast.evidence: Her name and photo appear in a graphic with the text "CHRIS TAYLOR WINS WISCONSIN SUPREME COURT ELECTION" and "PROJECTED WINNER".
